svg.title: Three scan schedules, one set of destinations
svg.desc: One row of eight columns with validity [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1] and three ways to number its survivors. Panel a, the rowwise kernel and the MLX composition: cumsum(v) - v over the whole row gives destinations 0 to 4. Panel b, the hierarchical kernel with tiles of four columns: local positions within each tile, tile counts (3, 2), exclusive tile offsets (0, 3), then offset plus local position. Panel c, the Metal kernel with four threads of two columns in two SIMD groups: chunk counts [1, 2, 1, 1], thread offsets [0, 1, 3, 4] from a SIMD prefix and group totals, then each thread writes its chunk in order. All three give destinations [0, -, 1, 2, -, 3, -, 4]. Sizes are schematic.
